packageRules.description: The bundled sniffers (wpcs, vipwpcs, slevomat, php_codesniffer, phpcompatibility) ARE this package's product: a bump changes the linting behaviour inherited by every downstream WPTechnix repo. Never automerge — a human reviews and re-runs the rulesets on each change. Ranges are widened so consumers keep a broad compatible window.
GitHub Actions: group into one PR, pin to commit SHAs, and automerge minor/patch/digest.
Major bumps always need a human — never automerge, and flag them.
